name: 十回の学習の進み方
prompt:
Create ONE isolated learning-session progress grid, high-resolution clean flat raster on purewhite canvas. Input1 ORIGINAL Headspace screenshot is PRIMARY authority for check/play icon glyph geometry, rounded triangle corners, circle proportions, optical weight, alignment and spacing. Input2 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY overall layout and Meiryo role guidance; its current-session color and roughsharp glyphs differ. Input3 official Lighthouse finish only, no bus.
Scope ONLY ten session circles and number labels from original region x73 y629 width1034 height432. NO dividers, teacher/download/other UI/extra titles. Compact grid5columns x2rows in342x143 logical units. Original circles about34x34, centers evenly spaced horizontally, same two-row alignment. Labels centered below each.
Exact sequence first row1 2 3 4 5; second6 7 8 9 10. Numerals Meiryo REGULAR40012px line16, letterspacing0, normal fine strokes, not bold. First3 dark #1D1D1D; inactive4–10 neutral #6E6E6E as Japanese mock for readability.
Session1 and2 completed: solid officialforest green circles #1F6444 with subtle restrained #174C36→#2D8F5E gradient, centered WHITE checks matching ORIGINAL short diagonal/long stroke and optical sizing, not mock elongated pointy checks. Session3 CURRENT playable: retain ORIGINAL meaningful saturated BLUE #3168F2 circle and centered white right-pointing gently rounded play triangle. Do NOT recolor session3 green; its distinct current state is meaningful evidence. Sessions4–10 unavailable: white circles with fine palegray outline and small palegray rounded play glyphs matching original. No random accent colors, no mint fills, no shadow. Slate applies supporting utility icons; these state glyphs remain white/palegray inside semantic status circles as originals. Preserve original compact rhythm, exact count/order/states. No annotations, no extra marks/text, no app chrome.
reviewNotes: Grid inspected: correct1–10/stateorder, current3blue preserved, inactivewhitegray, Regularnumerals. Completed1/2green too bright relative officialforest and checks too large/rounded versus source. Bounded correction planned; no runtime/nativeclaim.
